axioms.name: pi_definition
axioms.note: definitional: pi is the circle ratio (equivalently, twice the smallest positive zero of cosine)

axioms.name: analysis_convergence_premises
axioms.note: analytic premises (provable in analysis/Mathlib, not carried in pure core): alternating-series error bounds, telescoping and integral tail bounds

axioms.name: euler_basel_identity
axioms.note: Euler 1735: comparing coefficients in the sine product gives sum 1/n^2 = pi^2/6 (and pi^4/90 for n^4)

axioms.name: apery_theorem
axioms.note: Apéry 1979: zeta(3) is irrational (theorem; no closed form known)

axioms.name: gelfond_schneider
axioms.note: Gelfond-Schneider theorem: e^pi is transcendental (theorem; assumed)

axioms.name: physical_constants_empirical
axioms.note: empirical/definitional: alpha is measured (CODATA 2018); c and h are SI-defined (2019); G is measured. No accepted parameter-free derivation exists for any of them

lemmas.name: zeta2_tail_symbolic
lemmas.gap: requires linarith/order reasoning over ℚ (Mathlib) or manual cross-multiplication; general shape of the tail sandwich verified concretely in scripts/column3/03_zeta2_basel.py

lemmas.name: gamma_rational_target
lemmas.gap: DELIBERATE TARGET, EXPECTED UNPROVEN: gamma has no known closed form and its irrationality is itself an OPEN problem (Erdos prize). Any proof would show gamma rational — believed false. This sorry marks the class-O boundary: constants definable and computable to any precision yet not closed-form-derivable

lemmas.name: alpha_physical_target
lemmas.gap: DELIBERATE TARGET, EXPECTED UNPROVEN (trilogy link to speed-of-light-derivation-tct): no accepted parameter-free derivation of the fine-structure constant. Numerology-class claims are registered REFUSED: WOULD_BE_GUESS in the ledgers
